decks.notes: The primary focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal, and hand disruption. The deck aims to maintain control of the board with cards like Fatal Push and Archmage's Charm while also disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Sink into Stupor and Thought Scour. Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters provide threats on the battlefield while Psychic Frog offers card advantage. The deck's mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells and ensures consistent access to both blue and black mana sources.

The deck focuses on assembling UrzaTron (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana for powerful plays like Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust. It utilizes Eldrazi creatures like Devourer of Destiny and World Breaker, along with Sowing Mycospawn tokens, to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures and The One Ring provide additional protection and win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to establish dominance through efficient mana production and overwhelming threats.

The main theme of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. By using efficient removal like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, along with countermagic such as Force of Negation and Counterspell, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from developing their board state. Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog provide win conditions, while cards like Consign to Memory and Cling to Dust offer additional disruption and card advantage. The deck also includes various cantrips to help find key pieces and control the game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, Emrakul, and Devourer of Destiny. It uses cards like Eldrazi Temple and Through the Breach to generate mana and cheat out big threats early in the game. Control elements like Ugin's Labyrinth and All Is Dust help to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi creatures while maintaining control of the game through a combination of ramp and disruption.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive creatures. By using cards like Fatal Push and Counterspell to deal with threats, along with creatures like Tasigur, the Golden Fang and Basim Ibn Ishaq to apply pressure, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Cling to Dust and Sink into Stupor also provide additional disruption and card advantage. Overall, the goal is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and control tactics.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Control elements are included with cards like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble to clear the board of threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures while disrupting their game plan with removal and disruption spells. The deck aims to control the game through mana acceleration and powerful threats to ensure victory.

This deck focuses on establishing control over the game by using a combination of artifact synergy, counterspells, and card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The centerpiece of the deck is The One Ring, which provides a powerful win condition while also enabling additional card draw and mana acceleration. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga help to consistently recur key artifacts, while cards like Force of Negation and Metallic Rebuke provide disruption to opponent's game plans. The goal is to outvalue and out-tempo opponents until securing victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game through the use of powerful Eldrazi creatures and artifacts. The key components include efficiently assembling UrzaTron lands to generate massive amounts of mana, using Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponents' strategies, and casting devastating board wipes like All Is Dust. By utilizing a combination of disruption, ramp, and powerful threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory in the late game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating value and potentially winning the game in a single turn. It includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to fill the graveyard, alongside Grinding Station and The One Ring to help facilitate the combo. The addition of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Six','','');">Wrenn and Six provide additional card advantage and flexibility, making the deck a powerful and versatile force in the Modern format.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to establish a strong board presence quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck also utilizes the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for added flexibility. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison help control the board, while creatures like Guide of Souls and Amped Raptor provide powerful attacks. The deck aims to win through constant pressure and efficient use of its resources to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck revolves around quickly putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. The goal is to reanimate creatures like Griselbrand or Ulamog, the Defiler to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help protect the combo pieces while Flooded Strand and Marsh Flats provide mana fixing. The deck also includes ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending. This combo-focused deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and graveyard recursion.

The deck focuses on creating infinite loops and generating huge amounts of mana using cards like Underworld Breach, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Wish to cast multiple spells in a single turn. The goal is to achieve a quick victory by utilizing Lotus Field and Dream's Grip to generate an enormous amount of mana, allowing for powerful spells and combos to be played consecutively. Tolaria West and Expedition Map are used to tutor for key pieces of the combo, while Consign to Memory provides disruption for the opponent.

The deck focuses on generating fast mana and card advantage to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames to create a storm-like effect. By utilizing cards like Manamorphose, Glimpse the Impossible, and Ruby Medallion, the deck aims to chain together multiple spells in a single turn to overwhelm the opponent. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion providing additional mana acceleration and flexibility. The deck's win condition primarily revolves around casting spells in succession and utilizing Ral's ability to deal damage directly to the opponent.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse/Curiosity to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also includes control elements like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large, hard-to-deal-with threats while also having answers for various types of threats through its versatile spell selection.

This deck focuses on using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to control the opponent's board and hand while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters. It also utilizes effects like Psychic Frog and Cling to Dust to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of cheap interaction, card filtering, and efficient threats, this Dimir Control deck aims to outvalue its opponent and control the game until it can take over with its powerful creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending to quickly bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog, the Defiler onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation while consistently reanimating threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Fallaji Archaeologist to control the board and maintain card advantage. This combo-oriented deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats before they can stabilize.
